eyebrow: The Platform App Builder's design order
code:
1. Reuse a standard object before building a custom one
2. Reuse a standard field before building a custom one
3. Configure (fields, layouts, flows) before you customize
4. Customize (components) before anyone writes Apex
5. Ask "does this already exist in the org?" at every step
caption: The exam and the job both reward the most declarative solution that actually meets the requirement — not the most impressive one.
